name: Kanban
description: A kanban board that lives in a git repo. Point it at a GitHub repository and it clones, serves and syncs the board through git-kanban.

settings.label: Board repository
settings.description: A git URL holding the board. Cloned into the folder below if it is not there yet.

settings.label: Board folder
settings.description: Project-relative. Use "." to make this project its own board.

settings.label: Server port
settings.description: Where kanban serve listens. Two boards on one machine need two ports.
